pm_exper_user_4148_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Since you enjoy rugby more than ice hockey, I’d recommend catching the Six Nations Championship when it kicks off — the New Zealand vs. England test match will have plenty of drama, and France’s clash with Wales is always fiery. If you want a late-night adrenaline fix from Wellington, the Super Rugby opener between the Crusaders and Hurricanes will be a thrilling watch.
(b) If you’re looking for exciting winter sports this season, the IIHF World Championship features some high-intensity matchups like Canada vs. USA and Sweden vs. Finland. For something a bit different, the Kitzbühel downhill in the FIS Alpine World Cup delivers non-stop action and atmosphere.
(c) Since you enjoy ice hockey more than rugby, I’d recommend catching the upcoming IIHF World Championship games — the Canada vs. USA clash is shaping up to be fierce, and Sweden’s matchup against Finland always brings high drama. If you want a late-night adrenaline fix from Wellington, the NHL’s Battle of Alberta between the Flames and Oilers in February will be a thrilling watch.
(d) Since you enjoy alpine skiing more than rugby, I’d recommend catching the upcoming FIS Alpine World Cup — the Kitzbühel downhill is packed with speed and spectacle, and the slalom in Schladming is legendary for its electric atmosphere. If you want a late-night adrenaline fix from Wellington, the Beaver Creek races in December will be a thrilling watch.
